variableMeasured.name: rt
variableMeasured.description: The response time in milliseconds for the participant to make a response. The time is measured from when the second stimulus first appears on the screen until the participant's response.

variableMeasured.name: response
variableMeasured.description: Indicates which key the participant pressed.

variableMeasured.name: correct
variableMeasured.description: `true` if the participant's response matched the target.

variableMeasured.name: grid
variableMeasured.description: The representation of the grid. This will be encoded as a JSON string when data is saved using the `.json()` or `.csv()` functions.

variableMeasured.name: element_index
variableMeasured.description: Position of this element within its source array column (0-based).

variableMeasured.name: trial_index
variableMeasured.description: Join key referencing the position of an enclosing array element (0-based index).

variableMeasured.name: grid.element_index
variableMeasured.description: Join key referencing the position of an enclosing array element (0-based index).

variableMeasured.name: target
variableMeasured.description: The representation of the target location on the grid. This will be encoded as a JSON string when data is saved using the `.json()` or `.csv()` functions

variableMeasured.name: trial_type
variableMeasured.description: The name of the plugin used to run the trial.

variableMeasured.name: time_elapsed
variableMeasured.description: The number of milliseconds between the start of the experiment and when the trial ended.
